name: Sustain supportive listening over repeated conversations
short_description: Sustain supportive listening over repeated conversations once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can sustain supportive listening over repeated conversations in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Sustain supportive listening over repeated conversations means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Sustain supportive listening over repeated conversations in a fresh real-life scenario.
